t: Who actually counts as maintaining ties
a: لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنِ الْوَاصِلُ الَّذِي إِذَا قَطَعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا
p: Laysa-l-wāṣilu bi-l-mukāfiʾ, wa lākini-l-wāṣilu-lladhī idhā qaṭaʿat raḥimuhu waṣalahā
m: The one who maintains ties is not the one who repays in kind. The one who maintains ties is the one who, when his relatives cut him off, keeps connecting.
